title: Opta Qualifier IDs
description: Qualifiers add context to events. Each event has a qualifier array where each entry has a numeric qualifierId and optional value.
notes: Qualifier 213 is defined in the F24 spec as expectedGoals but is not populated in the theanalyst.com feed.
Use qualifiers 321 and 322 from the separate matchexpectedgoals endpoint for xG and xGOT.

location.name: involvedPlayer
location.notes: Other player involved in the event

goal.name: ownGoal
goal.notes: Own goal. contestantId is the team that scored it; credit opposing team.

goal.name: goalMouthY
goal.notes: Y coordinate in goal mouth (45.2-54.8 range)

goal.name: goalMouthZ
goal.notes: Z coordinate / height in goal mouth (0-38 range)

xg.name: expectedGoals
xg.notes: xG value on matchexpectedgoals endpoint only, not on standard matchevent

xg.name: expectedGoalsOnTarget
xg.notes: xGOT value on matchexpectedgoals endpoint only

context.name: formationSlot
context.notes: Formation position of player coming on (1-11)

shotPosition.name: shotEndX
shotPosition.notes: X coordinate where shot crossed goal plane

shotPosition.name: shotEndY
shotPosition.notes: Y coordinate where shot crossed goal plane

referencedOnly.name: unknown
referencedOnly.notes: Referenced in event-types docs: Save events can also be outfield with qualifier 94. The packaged docs do not provide a full qualifier-table definition.

referencedOnly.name: expectedGoals
referencedOnly.notes: Defined in the F24 spec as expectedGoals, but not populated in the theanalyst.com matchevent feed. Use 321/322 from matchexpectedgoals instead.
